title: Bloom Energy upgraded at BMO as Anthropic IPO revives AI infrastructure trade
summary: Investing.com -- Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) was upgraded to Outperform from Market Perform at BMO Capital Markets on Thursday. Analyst Ameet Thakkar cut his price target to $230 from $260 alongside the upgrade, arguing the recent pullback has left the stock’s risk-reward looking considerably better, with demand for AI-related power infrastructure still the central growth story.
